A '''broach''' or '''brooch''' was a kind of jewelry. [[Raflkind Industrials]] designed [[Radiation Screener]]s in the form of stylish broaches.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> [[Rivoche Tarkin]] owned a [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]] [[Rivoche Tarkin's brooch|brooch]] that was actually a disguised [[ZZip Product Concepts Limited|zZip]] [[Personality Series ChaumScanner 5]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] detector and [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
